title: Oil Supply Risks Rise After Saudi Pipeline Attack
summary: Saudi Arabia shut its East-West Pipeline as a precaution after multiple attacks, threatening a crucial route for moving crude to the Red Sea while bypassing disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. Bloomberg Economics' Ziad Daoud says prolonged disruption could tighten global energy supplies further, adding pressure to oil and US diesel prices. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Modi Seeks BRICS Unity as Global Tensions Rise
summary: India is seeking to forge consensus among an expanded BRICS membership despite divergent positions on the Iran war, relations with the US and the bloc's role in the global order. Joining David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend is Bloomberg News Senior Reporter Dan Strumpf who explains that the summit is also highlighting a tentative India-China rapprochement, with President Xi Jinping visiting New Delhi and China Southern Airlines preparing to restore its Guangzhou-New Delhi service after a six-year suspension. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Can Venezuela Rescue the Oil Market?
summary:
Venezuela has some of the world’s largest oil reserves and could eventually produce far more than it does today. But Columbia University’s Luisa Palacios says reviving the industry would take years, up to $150 billion in investment and a major rebuilding of trust after decades of contract changes, expropriations and infrastructure decline. 
 (Source: Bloomberg)
